original_test_intent: Prove that the BMC handles a deliberately full System Event Log predictably, retains usable IPMI and Redfish management through the defined MC reset, and can be returned to a healthy logging state without losing required evidence.
original_method: Identify the BMC, SEL capacity/reservation/overflow behavior and meaning of the literal raw record; export existing SEL and capture baseline management health; obtain approval for one bounded fill operation and define count/full/timeout/abort; append the approved synthetic event while recording every response and periodic `sel info`; stop exactly at the approved full condition; capture full/overflow and record behavior; issue the separately approved MC reset; measure disconnect/reconnect and verify `mc info`, Redfish version/health and logging behavior; preserve all evidence, then run the approved SEL cleanup/restoration and verify capacity only after adjudication.
manual_activity: The BMC owner approves the raw record, capacity-aware repeat/stop rule, maintenance window, MC reset and cleanup; the agent may execute only that bounded plan and collect management evidence.
required_inputs: SUT/BMC model, firmware and SEL implementation/capacity/overflow policy
Vendor-approved decoding and expected result of raw NetFn0x0a Cmd0x44 payload
Baseline SEL export location, protected real-event policy and synthetic-record identifier
Initial/free entry count, maximum append count, polling interval, full-state oracle, timeout and abort thresholds
Approved MC reset command/type, reconnect timeout and independent recovery path
Secure IPMI/Redfish endpoints plus post-full/post-reset health and approved cleanup/restoration procedure
safety_requirements: Use only a dedicated non-production SUT and export/preserve all real SEL records before filling
Validate the exact raw record against the BMC specification; do not loop unexplained bytes
Bound the append count from verified capacity and stop on full, overflow, unexpected record, latency/error threshold or BMC instability
Do not clear SEL before full-state and post-reset evidence are reviewed; cleanup is not permission to hide failures
Require explicit approval for the management-disrupting MC reset and monitor reconnect through an independent path
Use injected credentials and verified target identity; do not expose passwords or disable identity checks
Never automatically retry a failed append/reset, power-cycle the SUT or improvise recovery
agent_execution_scope: Validate target, raw record semantics, capacity, baseline export and bounded plan
After approval, append and poll exactly as specified while preserving every response/fullness checkpoint
After separate reset approval, capture reconnect, IPMI, Redfish, SEL and general BMC health
Do not guess counts/commands, clear evidence, reset without approval, retry automatically or decide PASS/FAIL
engineer_actions: Approve raw event meaning, initial capacity and bounded fill/full oracle
Approve maintenance window, MC reset type, timeout and recovery
Approve evidence preservation and later cleanup/restoration
Review full/post-reset management evidence and issue the DUT verdict

command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the exact source raw append only after vendor decoding; execute a capacity-bounded approved loop with periodic `ipmitool sel info`, then the approved MC reset, `mc info`, Redfish version/health, SEL export and separately approved cleanup.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Literal raw payload, fill-to-full intent, `sel info`, MC Reset, IPMI `mc info`, Redfish version/function, Common branch, internal Script reference and 15/30-minute estimate are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Perform one capacity-aware synthetic SEL fill with full evidence, then an approved reset/reconnect and management-health checkpoint before restoring SEL capacity.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw-record provenance, real-log preservation, bounded capacity math, full/overflow semantics, reset timing, secure Redfish and controlled cleanup.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: One successful append cannot prove full-log behavior; `mc info` alone cannot prove Redfish or logging recovery, and clearing immediately would destroy the stress evidence.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A full SEL can suppress real hardware events and degrade diagnostics; reset behavior and overflow policy are firmware-specific.

review_improvement: Converts an ineffective one-entry sample into the source-required bounded full-volume test, preserves real diagnostics and restores omitted reset/Redfish/recovery coverage without guessing destructive commands.
independent_technical_reasoning: SEL capacity is finite and may use wrap, reject-new-entry or overflow-flag behavior. One append cannot reach or characterize that boundary, while an unbounded loop can erase or suppress real fault evidence. The literal raw payload must be known to be a harmless synthetic record so the resulting log is auditable. Because MC reset interrupts the very management plane being tested, reset type and reconnect evidence are distinct from SEL fullness. Cleanup must occur only after evidence capture and cannot be treated as an automatic recovery retry.
